## How I tested it
- [ ] Ran the UI in a browser (light and dark)

## Checklist
- [ ] Small, focused change
- [ ] UI text is in English and nothing is clipped on a 360 px wide screen
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Entry added under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] I accept the contribution terms in `LICENSE` (section 4)
